methodology: Round 3: Data-driven picks from the most statistically predictable assets. Selected by Wilson score lower bound (95% CI) on closed trades across Battleground (300 trades), Alpha Engine (81 trades), and Cross-Aggregation Consensus (121 trades). Regime-aligned with HMM Bear state (98.19% confidence). Kelly Quarter sizing with all 7 guardrails. These picks compete against the 5 AI tournament picks as a 'statistical baseline' category.

selection_criteria.regime_alignment: SHORT in Bear regime (98.19% HMM confidence)

statistical_basis.data_quality: HIGHEST — largest sample size in tournament

picks.rationale: BTCUSDT SHORT has 70.3% WR on 64 closed trades — Wilson LB 58.2% means 95% confident true WR > 58%. Keltner compression is the dominant winning strategy (69.2% WR, 52 trades). Conservative 2% TP, 2% SL for R:R 1.0 because the edge comes from win rate, not payoff ratio.

statistical_basis.data_quality: HIGH — SOL-specific Keltner variant adds confidence

picks.rationale: SOLUSDT SHORT has 63.2% WR on 38 trades. SOL-specific Keltner variant adds 64.1% WR on 39 trades. Currently the ONLY profitable pick in the entire Phase 2 tournament (Claude's SOL SHORT at +0.17%). Regime-aligned, momentum confirmed.

statistical_basis.note: ETH has edge BOTH directions (55.6% SHORT, 61.8% LONG on 68 trades). HMM shows Accumulation which could flip this. Lower confidence than BTC/SOL.

picks.rationale: ETHUSDT SHORT has 55.6% WR on 36 trades but +20.48% cumulative PnL (winners are larger). RSI confluence on ETH specifically adds 60.5% on 38 trades. CAVEAT: HMM shows ETH in Accumulation phase (72%) — this pick carries higher contrarian risk than BTC/SOL. Smallest Kelly sizing reflects this uncertainty.

tournament_context.purpose: Test whether pure statistical edge (high WR on closed trades) outperforms AI-curated picks in live market conditions. This is the 'quant baseline' the AIs must beat.
tournament_context.evaluation: Same rules as all AIs: track P/L% until TP/SL hit or manual close. Compare avg P/L% to the 5 AI tournament participants.

avoided_assets.forex: 0% WR across 8+ trades — every forex strategy losing
avoided_assets.any_LONG_without_accumulation: Bear regime 98% — only ETH shows accumulation signal
